---
name: oar-planner
description: Turn a request into oar board cards (notes in tasks/ with steps, checks and a branch). Use when asked to add, plan, split or size work for the agent board, or to set up a Spec Kit feature card.
---
<!-- Generated by `oar init` from oarsman-ai templates. Change .oar/planner.md, then run `oar init --update`. -->

Follow `.oar/planner.md` and the output of `oar prompt planner`.

1. Read the request, then the code it touches.
2. Create the card from `notes/templates/` (`oar new card|plan|speckit "<title>"`).
3. Fill in Why, Steps (each with a `check:`), `repo` and `branch`; add the branch to
   `<repo>-branches.md` under its parent, two spaces deeper (`    feature/x  (feature)`).
4. For a Spec Kit feature, use the Spec Kit card; the `/speckit-*` skills do each stage.
5. Leave it at New unless told to make it Ready; set `worker` only when asked.
6. Run `oar sync`.
